text: Designed controlled multi-agent LLM experiments to measure how false beliefs and behavioral tendencies propagate across agent networks under different topologies, seeding methods, transmission modes, correction policies, and claim types.

Built reproducible Python workflows to execute multi-agent LLM trials, aggregate generation- and network-level metrics, and identify conditions associated with amplification, containment, and source laundering.
Translated research on emergent misalignment and hidden trait transmission into testable hypotheses and evaluation protocols for a manuscript on behavioral propagation and alignment risk.
Designed an ML benchmarking framework to compare accuracy, latency, and memory tradeoffs across post-training quantization and quantization-aware training strategies.
Built reproducible data, training, and evaluation workflows with configuration management, validation checks, and automated metric logging for model quantization experiments.
Led a machine learning capstone team developing and evaluating quantization strategies for AI models, coordinating implementation around accuracy, latency, and memory objectives.
Prototyped MCP-based agent interactions demonstrating how AI agents can retrieve, verify, and process financial data through tool-based workflows.
Built a Python simulation of the loan-application workflow to model how MCP-enabled agents could automate credit evaluation, document retrieval, and lender communication.
Applied graph neural networks to generate joint structural-functional embeddings of logic gates for identifying vulnerabilities in obscured integrated circuits.
Benchmarked graph-neural-network embedding performance on ISCAS-85 circuits and evaluated robustness to logic-preserving transformations including inverter insertions and De Morgan rewrites.
Executed structural-sensitivity experiments showing that learned circuit embeddings preserved functional similarities despite structural and layout differences.

Designed and implemented full-stack features and workflow automations for enterprise trade systems, translating regulatory requirements into technical specifications, application logic, and user-facing forms.
Developed SAP and ABAP programs and enterprise forms from functional requirements, documenting system logic and validating implementations against business and compliance requirements.
Translated federal and international trade regulations into implementable software requirements and workflows for enterprise compliance systems.
Supported Phase 1 of an SAP GTS implementation by mapping cross-border process automations, product-classification workflows, and compliance processes and surfacing system gaps and risks.
Tracked issues, dependencies, and blockers across system-integration workflows and aligned technical and business stakeholders on timelines for an SAP GTS rollout.
Analyzed enterprise trade and compliance workflows to identify opportunities for automation while coordinating requirements across business processes and technology systems.
Mentored computer engineering students on connecting C programs to ARM assembly and debugging low-level programming concepts through targeted assignments.
Published research on structural isolation in circuit optimization after conducting machine-learning and hardware-security experiments on integrated-circuit representations.
Built technical research and engineering workflows in Python using PyTorch, NumPy, Pandas, and scikit-learn for machine learning experimentation, evaluation, and data analysis.
